nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: Management did not give specific quarterly guidance for Q2 FY27. In November 2025, management projected FY26 revenue around ₹12,500 crore with about 5% growth the coming year (FY27), average margins around 15% plus, or 12% to 15% for new projects. Q2 FY27's reported 16.5% revenue decline and 8.1% EBITDA margin fall well below these annual ranges.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so. And the coming year also, we should have may be another 5% growth over that
If it is some newer vessels, it may not necessarily be that high. But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins
But that will not be the case for the new projects coming in, where we are booking the actual value of production. And in that case, we expect that the margins will be around 12% to 15%

nse:106823051.question: What has management said about this on its recent calls?
nse:106823051.answer: Management did not discuss any distrust of intermediate CAs, root CA distrust, or key generation flaws. The closest discussion occurred in the Q4 FY26 call, where management stated that a Google policy change regarding multi-purpose and new root certificates had no impact because existing roots remained trusted while new roots were queued.

evidence.quote: Our new roots have been submitted some time back

So, nothing stops for us because our existing roots are already trusted on Google and we basically have a transition period where the existing roots will continue to work until the new roots are accepted by Google
So, there is really no impact as such

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106818788.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106818788.answer: Management did not provide explicit forward-looking guidance on specific numbers for revenue or margins for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. However, on the Q1 FY27 call, they stated an aspiration to achieve 16% to 17% EBIT margins over time. For Q2 FY27, reported revenue reached 4,663.9 crore with an EBIT margin of 15% and an EBITDA margin of 13.6%.

evidence.quote: We achieved a healthy revenue growth of 7.8% quarter-on-quarter and 20% year-on-year delivering USD 487.6 million in Q2 FY27
The EBIT margin for the quarter came in at 15%, translating to an EBIT growth of 1.6% quarter-on-quarter and 19.5% year-on-year
In rupee terms, the growth for the quarter came in at 8.4% quarter-on-quarter and 30.3% year-on-year

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: Management said in May 2026 that consolidated revenue would accelerate and EBITDA margins would expand in FY27, backed by operating leverage and Centers of Excellence. In August 2026, Q2 FY27 revenue reached 803.1 crore (+52.6% YoY) and EBITDA margin reached 14.1%, showing revenue growth but lower margins due to increased user acquisition spending.

evidence.quote: Going into FY '27, Nazara is at a materially different scale than it was 12 months ago
The quality and earnings capacity of the platform have also expanded significantly, and we will continue to accelerate growth both in revenues and EBITDA in FY '27

nse:106823393.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106823393.answer: Management stated in October 2026 that over the next 1 to 2 years, food delivery margins are expected to remain flattish as they invest in growth. For Q2 FY27, consolidated revenue reached ₹24,138.0 crore and the EBITDA margin was 3.1%, up from 1.8% a year ago, reflecting strong profitability alongside growth investments.

evidence.quote: Directionally, we want to maintain margins broadly and reinvest in growth as much as it makes sense to continue to drive the growth upwards
It's hard to project or comment on margin trajectory every quarter but broadly, over the next 1 or 2 years, we expect the margins to remain flattish

nse:106810133.question: What has management said about debt, leverage and its credit profile?
nse:106810133.answer: Management stated that core infrastructure net external debt is around INR 45,000 crores, which is heavily supported by a regulatory asset base of under $4 billion. For metals, materials, and mining, net external debt is about $2 billion against operating assets of $6 billion. Management guides leverage in core infra to be in the 3.5x to 4.5x range (at 3.9x currently), and lower for mining.

evidence.quote: for example, in core infra, which is platform, we have a net external debt of, say, INR45,000 crores, which is about just under $5 billion. Against that, the regulatory asset base itself is just under $4 billion.

the metals, materials and mining, we have a net external debt of about $2 billion, against where we call our operating assets, which are roughly around about $6 billion. So we keep a low or very conservative leverage profile on the metal, materials and mining side,

our core infra will track the core infra. So we guide to that in the core infra while we are growing, we will be closer to the 3.5 to 4.5 range. And obviously, we'll be lower in relation to the mining.

nse:106805308.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106805308.answer: Management announced that the RBI approved Mr. Anup Bagchi as Managing Director and CEO for three years effective October 27, 2026, succeeding Mr. Sashidhar Jagdishan. Mr. Bagchi stated his focus on engaging with stakeholders, aligning priorities with macroeconomic and technological developments, and building on the bank's strong foundation.

evidence.quote: I'm really grateful to the Board for the trust placed in me as MD and CEO
As macroeconomic dynamics evolve and AI technology and digital infrastructures accelerate, we'll focus on capturing these opportunities with prudence and discipline

nse:106819733.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106819733.answer: Management stated in October 2026 that they will raise USD 1.25 billion through debt and equity to replace an 18-month bridge loan and fund long-term financing for the Nagarro acquisition. Of this, USD 450 million will come from equity, qualified institutional placement, or equity-linked instruments like FCCBs.

evidence.quote: As a part of this long-term financing strategy, we will be raising USD 1.25 billion in terms of both debt and equity
Out of this, USD 450 million will be raised through equity, qualified institutional placement or equity-linked instruments like FCCB or combination of similar instruments

nse:106831929.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106831929.answer: Management stated on recent calls that post stabilization, assets including Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway are expected to add well over INR3,000 crores to EBITDA. Q2 FY27 unaudited results show revenue grew 13% QoQ to ₹37,215.6 crore and profit before tax rose 248.4% QoQ to ₹2,002 crore.

evidence.quote: In the next fiscal year, AEL is set to unlock EBITDA from Navi Mumbai Airport, Kutch Copper and Ganga Expressway, which are expected to add over INR3,000 crores EBITDA to AEL
Post stabilization, these 3 assets are expected to add well over INR3,000 crores to EBITDA

nse:106830187.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830187.answer: Management did not discuss revenue or margin expectations for Q2 FY27 during the Q4 FY26 earnings call held on April 28, 2026. The discussion was focused on the results and outlook for FY26 and general growth expectations for FY27.

evidence.quote: The broad expectation, which our Chairman also conveyed, is growth of over 10% this year as compared to the last year
So it's always difficult to give out a guidance on margins

nse:106829216.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829216.answer: Management stated on the Q4 FY26 call in May 2026 that they expected revenue growth acceleration across payments and financial services for fiscal 2027, along with an EBITDA margin of 15% to 20% in the medium term. For Q2 FY27, revenue reached ₹2,648.0 crore (+28.5% YoY) and EBITDA margin was 10.2%, matching the growth acceleration.

evidence.quote: yes, we expect that to be a contributor going forward. It has been a bit of a drag last year, but we think the growth will be across the board

I know in the past you've talked about a medium term aspirational margin of 15 to 20% EBITDA and you have ended the year at about 6% with very strong expansion. Qualitatively, how far away are we from getting to that 15 to 20% EBITDA margin number
